leagues.name: SailGP (Rolex SailGP Championship)
notes: 13 national teams in the 2026 season; official team names carry title/naming partners (sailgp.com team pages, fetched 2026-09-25): BONDS Flying Roos (AUS), Mubadala Brazil (BRA), NorthStar (CAN), ROCKWOOL Racing (DEN), DS Automobiles SailGP Team France (FRA), Emirates Great Britain (GBR), Germany SailGP Team presented by Deutsche Bank (GER), Red Bull Italy (ITA), Black Foils (NZL), Los Gallos (ESP), Artemis (SWE), Explora Journeys Swiss SailGP Team (SUI), United States (USA).

Calendar-year competition (Jan-Nov 2026), so season is bare 2026. 13 Sail Grands Prix from Oracle Perth (17-18 Jan 2026) to the Mubadala Abu Dhabi Grand Final (28-29 Nov 2026); the two closing rounds are in the UAE (sailgp.com/races/ calendar, fetched 2026-09-25).

League partner tiers per sailgp.com/about/partners/overview/ (fetched 2026-09-25): Presenting Partner Rolex; Global Partners DP World, Emirates, Mubadala, Oracle; Official Partners Accor, Apex, KPMG. Red Bull was announced as a new global partner in January 2026 (sailgp.com press release, publishDate 2026-01-15) but does not yet appear on the partners overview page.

Boat livery/event-host shape: SailGP has no shirts in the schema sense - team naming partners brand the F50 boats and team identity. Mapped team title/naming partners to placement 'front' and team partners to 'partner'; the event-host shape (13 events with title/presenting partners) is recorded in unsourced because no event entity exists yet.
League founded 2018 by Larry Ellison and Russell Coutts, operated by F50 League LLC (Wikipedia lead, not cited).

proposedRatings.reasoning: Mubadala is Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, sitting under the Government of Abu Dhabi in the UAE. It is simultaneously a SailGP league global partner, owner of the Brazil team (via Mubadala Capital) and title sponsor of two 2026 events, including the season Grand Final in Abu Dhabi. Same UAE state money as Emirates: 43 activists sentenced to life in a 2024 mass trial, upheld by the Federal Supreme Court in March 2025. serious.

DP World's chain ends with the Government of Dubai (ultimate owner per the company's FY2025 annual report, already recorded in normalized/). At SailGP it is a global partner and presenting partner of the Dubai event - the same Dubai-government sportswashing pattern as Emirates, which is already rated serious with the UAE mass-trial claim. serious.

Rolex is a privately held Swiss family foundation (Hans Wilsdorf Foundation); no state in the ownership chain and no published SailGP deal value. none - but ownerId and ownership are null because the foundation chain was not verified to a primary source, so this proposal should only be applied once that is confirmed.

TEAM OWNERSHIP (Wikipedia leads, none cited): AUS - Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds joined Tom Slingsby as co-owners in June 2025 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia_SailGP_Team, opened); CAN - acquired Sep 2024 by Canadian biotech entrepreneur Dr Greg Bailey (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada_SailGP_Team, opened); ITA - consortium board director Assia Grazioli-Venier (Muse Capital), CEO Jimmy Spithill (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull_Italy_SailGP_Team, opened); ESP - sold to Quantum Pacific Group in April 2026 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain_SailGP_Team, opened; referenced to Boating New Zealand, 10 Apr 2026); SWE - Torbjorn Tornqvist, Gunvor co-founder (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artemis_Racing + SailGP article table, opened); SUI - Team Tilt / Firmenich family (SailGP article table, opened); US - Ryan McKillen listed as owner, Mike Buckley CEO (SailGP article table + en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_SailGP_Team, opened); NZ - MSP Sports Capital listed as owner in the SailGP article table (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SailGP, opened); DEN - 'Doug DeVos / American Magic' listed as owner in the SailGP article table, but the team page (https://www.sailgp.com/teams/rockwool-denmark/, fetched 2026-09-25) shows American Magic only as an Official Partner and ROCKWOOL as Title Partner - the ownership-vs-partnership distinction is unresolved.

GERMANY OWNERSHIP (sourced, recorded here because owners are kept minimal): the Germany SailGP Team's latest funding round added David Blitzer's family office Bolt and Blue Pool Capital as minority owners, joining team owner Thomas Riedel (founder, Riedel Communications), Sebastian Vettel, Holger Hubner (Wacken Open Air co-founder) and Ralf Reichert (ESL co-founder) - SailGP press release, 10 Feb 2026, https://www.sailgp.com/news/26/global-sports-heavyweights-join-germany-sailgp-team-ownership/ (opened, publishDate 2026-02-10).

BRAZIL OWNERSHIP (sourced): Mubadala Capital, 'the wholly-owned asset management subsidiary of Mubadala Investment Company', and SailGP announced on 21 Jun 2024 a strategic investment to acquire a newly-formed team representing Brazil; the team partners with Brazilian sports and entertainment firm IMM to operate it, founded by ex-Brazilian Olympic sailor Alan Adler (CEO) - https://www.sailgp.com/news/24/mubadala-capital-and-sailgp-announce-first-ever-south-american-sailgp-team/ (opened, publishDate 2024-06-21); Gulf News, 21 Jun 2024, https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/abu-dhabis-mubadala-capital-sailgp-acquires-sailgp-team-in-brazil-1.1718983842589 (opened: 'Mubadala Capital, a subsidiary of Mubadala Investment Company'). IMM's operating role and Alan Adler's ownership stake are not separately sourced.

LEAGUE OWNERSHIP (lead only, not cited): SailGP is owned by F50 League LLC, founded in 2018 by Larry Ellison (Oracle co-founder) and Russell Coutts, with initial funding from Ellison; since June 2026, following SailGP's sale of the Black Foils (New Zealand team), all 13 teams have been privately owned - en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SailGP (fetched 2026-09-25). No primary filing opened.

SUPPLY CHAIN - Mubadala-owned Strata Manufacturing, based in Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, manufactures new hydrofoils and rudders for the F50 fleet, per https://www.mubadala.com/en/sailgp (opened). A supply-chain state link, not a shirt sponsor.
